claim_and_estimand.claim: Within the exact four-world regime and deterministic dynamic TOP1 selection-and-cut policy, native local route/state activity has a positive causal contribution to task accuracy and that contribution is not reproduced by each prospectively capacity-adequate ordinary reduction in the frozen panel.
claim_and_estimand.policy_scope: TOP1_SELECTED_LOCAL_NODE_CUT_V1 dynamic policy; selected node identity may vary by episode and step.
claim_and_estimand.primary_estimand: Equal-weight mean across four worlds of episode-level paired accuracy loss baseline_minus_cut under the dynamic TOP1 policy.
claim_and_estimand.capacity_estimand: For each comparator, equal-weight mean across four worlds of episode-level baseline accuracy difference comparator_minus_native on the same formal evaluation episodes.
claim_and_estimand.reduction_estimand: For each comparator, equal-weight mean across four worlds of episode-level paired causal-effect difference comparator_delta_minus_native_delta.
claim_and_estimand.experimental_unit: episode seed; 24 recurrent step rows are within-episode observations and are never treated IID

source_protocol_package_binding.future_identity_binding_rule: A later Analyst-authorized one-way identity must bind the exact final source SHA, this contract blob SHA, exact runner/scorer/preserver blobs, package-manifest digest, runtime-manifest digest, input_surface_sha256, evaluator_spec_sha256, candidate/intervention/comparator IDs and decision rules before STARTED.

runtime_contract.runtime_freeze_gate: Future identity creation must record exact Python patch version, torch version, OS image identifier, canonical pip-freeze digest and relevant environment/thread settings before STARTED; mismatch is pre-execution BLOCKED, not a repair after result exposure.

input_surface.world_assignment: seed-list index modulo 4 in listed world order
input_surface.selection_derivation: Seed blocks and training seeds were deterministically derived from the R65 authority text plus role labels before contract materialization; they were not selected from PF-R1 outcomes.
input_surface.freshness_rule: No fit/calibration/evaluation seed may overlap PF-R1 ranges 7601000-7601047, 7602000-7602011, 7603000-7603023 or any consumed FORMAL identity. A later pre-START collision audit is mandatory.

resource_privilege_contract.data: Native and all ordinary comparators receive identical fresh fit/calibration/evaluation episode identities appropriate to their frozen algorithms; evaluation labels are unavailable to training/calibration.
resource_privilege_contract.labels: Symmetric training/calibration labels only; no future-step labels, protected evaluation labels, outcome-dependent exclusions or evaluator motif identity at prediction time.
resource_privilege_contract.compute: Native and trainable comparators receive four epochs, learning rate 0.012 and equal fit/calibration episode counts; FSA receives the same fit episodes; extra deterministic inference bookkeeping is allowed but may not expose extra labels/data.
resource_privilege_contract.intervention_privilege: All arms know baseline/cut status and use the same dynamic TOP1 policy semantics; FSA/eligibility receive only route/state information already frozen by DEV-R2.
resource_privilege_contract.evaluation: All endpoints use the same 256 formal episode seeds and four-world assignment with no post-hoc filtering.

evaluator.aggregation: Compute each arm metric within episode first; form paired episode contrasts; overall estimand is the equal-weight mean of four world-specific episode means.

uncertainty.resample_unit: episode seed within world, with replacement
uncertainty.pairing: same resampled episode indices reused for native baseline/cut and all comparator baseline/cut arms
uncertainty.note: Bonferroni simultaneous coverage over 8 preregistered contrasts; recurrent step rows are never treated IID.

evaluator.secondary_descriptive: Episode-aggregated mean total-variation distance is reported with the same stratified bootstrap but never changes the primary decision.

independent_capacity_and_effect_criteria.margin_selection_basis: Margins are zero by design, fixed independently of PF-R1. Allowing baseline under-capacity or a smaller intervention effect to count as ordinary reduction would confound under-capacity with mechanistic reproduction.
independent_capacity_and_effect_criteria.capacity_adequate: Simultaneous CI for comparator_baseline_minus_native_baseline has lower bound >= 0.
independent_capacity_and_effect_criteria.effect_reproduced: For a capacity-adequate comparator, simultaneous CI for comparator_delta_minus_native_delta has lower bound >= 0.
independent_capacity_and_effect_criteria.effect_conclusively_smaller: For a capacity-adequate comparator, simultaneous CI for comparator_delta_minus_native_delta has upper bound < 0.
independent_capacity_and_effect_criteria.ambiguous: Any required interval crossing its zero boundary is INCONCLUSIVE, never support for native mechanistic distinctness.
independent_capacity_and_effect_criteria.positive_phenomenon: Simultaneous CI for native_baseline_accuracy_minus_one_third has lower bound > 0.
independent_capacity_and_effect_criteria.native_local_effect: Simultaneous CI for native_delta_accuracy has lower bound > 0.
independent_capacity_and_effect_criteria.secondary_tv: Episode-aggregated mean total-variation is descriptive only and cannot rescue or overturn the primary accuracy decision.

formal_decision_table.FAIL_REDUCED_BY_ORDINARY_COMPARATOR: at least one comparator is capacity_adequate and effect_reproduced
formal_decision_table.PASS_LOCAL_DYNAMIC_POLICY_MECHANISTIC_DI: positive_phenomenon and native_local_effect pass, and for every frozen comparator capacity_adequate is established and effect_conclusively_smaller is established
formal_decision_table.INCONCLUSIVE: otherwise, including any comparator whose capacity adequacy is not established or whose effect contrast is ambiguous

intervention_validity.selection: Freeze unperturbed deterministic TOP1 selected[0] before cut; baseline/cut selected IDs must match exactly.
intervention_validity.input: Non-target input digest identical across paired arms.
intervention_validity.parameters: Model/comparator parameter digests identical across paired arms.
intervention_validity.rng: RNG state digest identical across paired arms.
intervention_validity.cut: Target previous state, local edge row/column and updated state are zeroed exactly as DEV-R2; cut state never carries forward.

one_way_integrity_design.raw_before_score: Future runner emits target-blind episode-level paired observations plus binding/runtime manifests, closes and hashes raw bytes, and terminates without computing PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE labels.
one_way_integrity_design.preserve_before_read: A separate preserver creates an immutable preserve ref/object containing exact raw bytes and hashes before any scorer is granted access; scorer input is preserved raw only, never the live runner workspace.
one_way_integrity_design.immutable_evidence_path: Only after preserve succeeds may the frozen scorer read raw and write a score artifact; evidence/formal/sealed refs require later Analyst authority and a no-clobber same-final-SHA path.
one_way_integrity_design.target_blind_raw: Raw artifact contains observations and metadata only, never a decision token.
one_way_integrity_design.no_clobber: Future identity, STARTED, preserve and evidence refs are create-only; any pre-existing exact identity/ref is a hard stop.
one_way_integrity_design.same_final_sha_gate: Future STARTED, runner, preserver and scorer verify exact source SHA and contract/scorer/preserver blob bindings before capability.

future_execution_sequence: Fresh Analyst reviews and explicitly authorizes this exact contract or a versioned replacement.
Implement and freeze exact runner, scorer and preserver without changing scientific semantics; bind blob hashes and exact runtime/package/input/evaluator identities.
Create a fresh one-way identity and preregister decision/falsifier rules; create STARTED with no-clobber at the same final SHA.
Fit/calibrate only on fresh fit/calibration surfaces under matched privilege/resources.
Generate formal evaluation episodes exactly once; execute paired baseline/cut observations and write target-blind raw before scoring.
Immutably preserve raw and binding/runtime manifests before scorer access.
Score only preserved raw with the frozen evaluator/decision table.
Persist score/evidence through create-only immutable refs and STOP.
this_cycle_authorized: ordinary non-result-bearing JSON/schema/lint/build/unit conformance if needed
science-invariant path/serialization/hash repairs preserving this already-fixed design intent
this_cycle_forbidden: margin/threshold/sample-size changes selected from PF-R1 outcomes
stop_rule: STOP after contract-design persistence and non-result-bearing conformance. Fresh Evidence Analyst review is required before identity creation, result-bearing workflow construction/dispatch, protected evaluation access, STARTED, preserve or scoring.
